copy.blurb: Our model carries a confidence band around every estimate, and on Côte d'Ivoire versus Ecuador the market price sits inside that band on all three sides. The point estimates (30% / 26% / 44%) run close to The Market, but more importantly the small differences that do exist are smaller than the model's own uncertainty about its number. Pass is what we publish when the signal is inside the noise. The bands tighten as kickoff nears.
